_about: Qiriness's routine settings the knowledge spreadsheet does not carry. `npm run advisor:load` assembles them with the spreadsheet's Routines and Rules tabs (data/advisor/qiriness-knowledge.json) into the routines the foundation engine runs (scripts/lib/advisory/assemble-routines.mjs). Brand data, edited here; the spreadsheet stays the master for foundations, steps, modules, concerns and products. PROPOSED values are ours until Qiriness confirms them.

concern_map._about: The customer's words (the lexicon's concern keys) → Qiriness's 20 standard concerns (the Rules tab's keys). Same map as the test bench, whose concerns are the template's.

_foundation_priority_note: PROPOSED (plan § 3.1): several concerns, none chosen with a button, the tie goes to the first. Qiriness to confirm.

foundations._about: Per foundation key (the Routines tab's letters). `targets`: the step types that must treat the foundation's concern (« never pad »: such a step stays empty rather than take a product that does not); PROPOSED from the bench. `skin_types`: a skin type that picks this foundation when no concern is given (owner, 2026-10-14). `texture`: every cream of this foundation. `tolerance_first`: « Déconseillé » for sensitive skin is never used. `only_on_explicit_request`: the basic routine.

C.rule: every product suits sensitive skin (« Adapté » or « Avec précaution »), never « Déconseillé »

E.premium_when: deep wrinkles or the customer asks for the most advanced care; never because of age alone

modules._about: Per module type (the Routines tab's modules). `when` adds to the tab's own concerns: the SPF module's are only in its note (« Taches ou teint irrégulier »).

questions._rule: the question whose answer changes the routine most first; skin traits before naming a concern; never age first (§ 3.3)

treats._rule: commercial offers, separate from the advice: one at most per conversation (§ 3.4). The products are the spreadsheet's « Petit plaisir » ones.
